noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 6 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.670 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.705, Score minimum: 0.622

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. magnetization (score: 0.705)
     - Q5 ratio: 2.03 vs bruit blanc 0.13
     - Hurst max: 1.030, Pente FFT: -0.386
  2. localvar (score: 0.685)
     - Q5 ratio: 2.07 vs bruit blanc 0.13
     - Hurst max: 1.105, Pente FFT: -0.339
  3. energy (score: 0.679)
     - Q5 ratio: 2.07 vs bruit blanc 0.13
     - Hurst max: 1.093, Pente FFT: -0.322

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. fliprate (score: 0.664)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.103
  2. flip (score: 0.664)
     - Hurst moyen: 1.103
  3. susceptibility (score: 0.622)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.971
